lines.zh: 巨大的翅膀扇动，发出低沉的隆隆声。
lines.en: Bulging wings flap, producing a rumbling sound.

lines.zh: 巨渡鸟沉重地迈步，步履蹒跚。
lines.en: Dolossal takes heavy steps, stumbling.

lines.zh: 翅膀边缘摩擦着岩石。
lines.en: Wings scrape against the rocks.

lines.zh: 它低吼着向前行进。
lines.en: It growls as it advances.

lines.zh: 翅膀掠过地面，尘土飞扬。
lines.en: Wings sweep over the ground, kicking up dust.

lines.zh: 沉重的羽毛在风中摇摆。
lines.en: Heavy feathers sway in the wind.

lines.zh: 它张开翅膀，准备起飞。
lines.en: It spreads its wings, preparing to take flight.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍打，发出震耳欲聋的声音。
lines.en: Wings beat with a thunderous sound.

lines.zh: 脚步沉重，如同巨石滚动。
lines.en: Steps heavy, like rolling boulders.

lines.zh: 翅膀扑腾，带起一阵旋风。
lines.en: Wings thump, stirring a whirlwind.

lines.zh: 爪子在石面上留下三道痕。
lines.en: My claws leave three grooves in the stone.

lines.zh: 尾羽扫过灌木，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My tail feathers rustle through the brush.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着远处的猎物。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on distant prey.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，仿佛随时准备攻击。
lines.en: Wings half-open, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 它沉默地站立着，耐心等待。
lines.en: It stands silently, waiting.

lines.zh: 注视着周围的环境，警惕性极高。
lines.en: It surveys its surroundings, highly alert.

lines.zh: 巨大的翅膀半合，显得威严。
lines.en: Large wings half-closed, imposing.

lines.zh: 它静静地观察，寻找机会。
lines.en: It watches quietly, searching for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻颤动，似乎感到不安。
lines.en: Wings tremble slightly, uneasy.

lines.zh: 它警惕地环视四周。
lines.en: It cautiously scans its surroundings.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻扇动，驱散空气中的尘埃。
lines.en: Wings flap gently, clearing dust from the air.

lines.zh: 安静地站立，等待着猎物的出现。
lines.en: It stands quietly, awaiting prey.

lines.zh: 收翅立在枯树上，像块石头。
lines.en: I perch on a dead tree like a stone.

lines.zh: 把头埋进翅膀里打盹。
lines.en: I tuck my head under my wing and doze.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出咕咕的低音。
lines.en: A low coo rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 数着头顶盘旋的秃鹫。
lines.en: I count the vultures circling above.

lines.zh: 突然，它的眼睛转向了你。
lines.en: Its eyes suddenly turn towards you.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了敌意。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with hostility.

lines.zh: 它察觉到了你的存在。
lines.en: It senses your presence.

lines.zh: 它的眼神锐利，寻找着弱点。
lines.en: Its sharp gaze seeks weaknesses.

lines.zh: 它凝视着你，似乎在评估。
lines.en: It stares at you, evaluating.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，紧盯着你的每一个动作。
lines.en: Stare intense, fixated on every move.

lines.zh: 它的眼中透露出危险的气息。
lines.en: Danger radiates from its eyes.

lines.zh: 眼神中充满了好奇。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with curiosity.

lines.zh: 它注意到了你的一举一动。
lines.en: It notices your every move.

lines.zh: 它的眼神充满警惕。
lines.en: Its gaze is wary.

lines.zh: 我的翼影盖住你，别抬头。
lines.en: My wing-shadow covers you; don't look up.

lines.zh: 我歪头，看清你的武器。
lines.en: I tilt my head to study your weapon.

lines.zh: 你身上有骨头的味道。
lines.en: You smell of bone.

lines.zh: 我的喙比你的剑长。
lines.en: My beak is longer than your sword.

lines.zh: 大翅膀一展，羽毛落了一地。
lines.en: My huge wings spread; feathers fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛没有眨过。
lines.en: These eyes have not blinked.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我已俯视你。
lines.en: When you look up, I am already looking down.

lines.zh: 你的羽毛太少了。
lines.en: You have far too few feathers.

lines.zh: 翼骨断了一根，我落回地上。
lines.en: One wing bone snaps; I drop back to the ground.

lines.zh: 脚受伤了，行动不便。
lines.en: Foot injured, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 肚子受伤了，疼得不行。
lines.en: Stomach injured, in pain.

lines.zh: 尾巴受了伤，尾巴垂下来。
lines.en: Tail injured, hangs down.

lines.zh: 翅膀被砍了，飞不远。
lines.en: Wings cut, can't fly far.

lines.zh: 翅膀被烧了，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: Wings burned, excruciating pain.

lines.zh: 翅膀被射伤，飞不稳。
lines.en: Wings shot, can't fly steady.

lines.zh: 翅膀被雷击了，动不了。
lines.en: Wings hit by lightning, paralyzed.

lines.zh: 翅膀被冻了，飞不动了。
lines.en: Wings frozen, can't fly.

lines.zh: 翅膀被咬了，血流不止。
lines.en: Wings bitten, bleeding badly.

lines.zh: 它的巨大羽翼闪烁着磷光，引诱你靠近！
lines.en: Its glowing feathers entice you closer.

lines.zh: 注意它的巨大喙，一啄就能致命！
lines.en: Watch out for its huge beak—it's deadly.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如同夜里的恶梦，让人难以抗拒！
lines.en: Its eerie call is a nightmare in the night.

lines.zh: 它的体型巨大，比普通的渡鸦大上数倍！
lines.en: Its massive size is several times that of a regular crow.

lines.zh: 别靠近，它的攻击范围远超你想象！
lines.en: Stay back, its range is greater than you think.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛像两颗燃烧的宝石，直视你！
lines.en: Its eyes are like burning gems, staring you down.

lines.zh: 它的羽毛在月光下显得格外妖异！
lines.en: Its feathers glow strangely under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它的叫声仿佛在呼唤死亡！
lines.en: Its call sounds like a deathly summons.

lines.zh: 它的喙长而尖，随时准备攻击！
lines.en: Its long, sharp beak is always ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的飞行轨迹如同幽灵一般飘忽！
lines.en: Its flight path is as ghostly as a phantom.

lines.zh: 小心，它会突然从空中俯冲下来！
lines.en: Be careful, it will suddenly dive from the sky.

lines.zh: 巨渡鸟似乎能预判你的动作！
lines.en: The dolossal seems to predict your movements.

lines.zh: 你和它撞在一起，感觉像是被巨鹰撞击！
lines.en: Colliding with it feels like an eagle hit you.

lines.zh: 它挥动翅膀，几乎掀翻了你！
lines.en: It flapped its wings, nearly knocking you over.

lines.zh: 它的体型庞大，你的撞击毫无作用！
lines.en: Its massive size rendered your impact useless.

lines.zh: 你和它撞在一起，两人都被震飞了！
lines.en: You both got knocked away in the collision.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，立刻感到一阵剧痛！
lines.en: You collide with it and feel intense pain.

lines.zh: 它的身体比你想象中更硬！
lines.en: Its body is harder than you imagined.

lines.zh: 巨大的翅膀扇动，将你撞得飞出去！
lines.en: Its huge wings knocked you away.

lines.zh: 它的体型让你难以近身攻击！
lines.en: Its size makes it hard to get close to attack.

lines.zh: 它寻找着伴侣，发出凄厉的叫声！
lines.en: It searches for a mate, issuing a mournful call.

lines.zh: 巨渡鸟在月光下寻找配偶，叫声凄凉！
lines.en: The dolossal searches for a mate under the moonlight, with a mournful call.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声如同灵魂的呼唤！
lines.en: Its mating call sounds like a soul's plea.

lines.zh: 巨渡鸟在空中盘旋，寻找配偶！
lines.en: The dolossal soars in the air, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它用叫声吸引伴侣，声音悠长而哀伤！
lines.en: It attracts a mate with a long, sorrowful call.

lines.zh: 巨渡鸟发出求偶信号，周围显得格外安静！
lines.en: The dolossal emits a mating signal, making everything silent.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在夜晚显得格外动听！
lines.en: Its call sounds particularly beautiful at night.

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋，寻找可以交配的生物！
lines.en: It circles in the sky, looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声似乎带有魔力！
lines.en: Its mating call seems magical.

lines.zh: 巨渡鸟在空中徘徊，寻找配偶的机会！
lines.en: The dolossal hovers in the air, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 发出一声尖锐的呼啸。
lines.en: Screams sharply.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍击声回荡在空旷的洞穴中。
lines.en: Wings flap loudly in the cave.

lines.zh: 巨渡鸟扑扇着巨大的翅膀。
lines.en: Dolossal flaps its huge wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀边缘发出轻微的啸声。
lines.en: Whispers from the wings.

lines.zh: 用喙轻敲地面寻找食物。
lines.en: Pecks the ground with its beak.

lines.zh: 发出咯咯的嘶鸣声。
lines.en: Gargles loudly.

lines.zh: 翅膀的阴影遮住了整个洞穴。
lines.en: Shadows obscure the entire cave.

lines.zh: 寻找新的领地飞行。
lines.en: Scans for new territory.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声。
lines.en: Rumbles quietly.

lines.zh: 翅膀在空中划出有力的弧线。
lines.en: Wings slice through the air with power.

lines.zh: 我收拢双翼，对准下面那个。
lines.en: I fold my wings and aim at the one below.

lines.zh: 翅膀迅速扑向目标。
lines.en: Wings snap toward the target.

lines.zh: 注视着猎物，眼中透出凶光。
lines.en: Glare at prey with malicious eyes.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的阴影渐渐拉长。
lines.en: Shadows stretch from the wings.

lines.zh: 锁定一个移动的目标。
lines.en: Locks on a moving target.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的骨节发出咔嚓声。
lines.en: Joints snap in the wings.

lines.zh: 远处那个小的，我盯上了。
lines.en: That small shape far off — I've picked it.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍击声伴随猎物。
lines.en: Wings thud in tandem with the prey.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备扑击。
lines.en: Locks on, prepares to strike.

lines.zh: 锁定并紧盯着猎物。
lines.en: Locks and stares at the prey.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我就朝你落。
lines.en: I fold my wings and drop toward you.

lines.zh: 你跑向树线，我飞得更快。
lines.en: Run for the treeline; I fly faster.

lines.zh: 风把气味送到我鼻前。
lines.en: The wind brings your scent to me.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只等你自己抬头。
lines.en: I do not cry out; I wait for you to look up.

lines.zh: 这片空地上，你没有遮挡。
lines.en: In this clearing you have no cover.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，再落下。
lines.en: I circle once before I descend.

lines.zh: 这副骨架子跑起来不慢。
lines.en: This old frame still runs fast.

lines.zh: 翅膀调整以瞄准猎物。
lines.en: Wings adjust for aim.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，瞄准射击。
lines.en: Locks prey, aims to shoot.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻微颤动，锁定目标。
lines.en: Wings tremble, locking target.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，调整姿态。
lines.en: Locks target, adjusts stance.

lines.zh: 翅膀在空中形成瞄准姿势。
lines.en: Wings form an aiming pose.

lines.zh: 瞄准并射击猎物。
lines.en: Aim and shoot the prey.

lines.zh: 翅膀迅速而精准地锁定目标。
lines.en: Wings quickly lock onto target.

lines.zh: 瞄准并准备扑向猎物。
lines.en: Aim and prepare to扑向 prey.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，调整翅膀角度。
lines.en: Aim at prey, adjust wing angles.

lines.zh: 从背光处俯冲，你看不清。
lines.en: I dive from the glare; you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 你的脖子露在外面。
lines.en: Your neck is exposed.

lines.zh: 矮树挡不住我的落点。
lines.en: Low trees will not stop my landing.

lines.zh: 我把影子对准你的脸。
lines.en: I line my shadow up with your face.

lines.zh: 等我拍第二下翅膀。
lines.en: Wait for my second wingbeat.

lines.zh: 你已在我落点的正中。
lines.en: You are already at the center of my landing.

lines.zh: 羽毛展开，是为了稳住。
lines.en: I spread my feathers to hold steady.

lines.zh: 最后一圈，风是直的。
lines.en: One last circle; the wind is straight.

lines.zh: 巨大的翅膀扇动，风声呼啸而过。
lines.en: Wings beat, wind whips past.

lines.zh: 羽毛撕裂空气，声音刺耳。
lines.en: Feathers slice air, a sharp sound.

lines.zh: 翅膀一拍，巨石碎裂。
lines.en: Wings strike, rocks shatter.

lines.zh: 巨大的喙啄向你，力道惊人。
lines.en: Large beak pecks, forceful.

lines.zh: 尖利的爪子抓破你的皮肤。
lines.en: Sharp claws tear at your skin.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，你被甩开。
lines.en: Tail swipe, you are flung away.

lines.zh: 巨喙发出闷响，扑向你。
lines.en: Mouth thuds, lunges at you.

lines.zh: 巨翅拍打，你难以站稳。
lines.en: Wings beat, you stagger.

lines.zh: 羽毛碰撞，激起一地灰尘。
lines.en: Feathers collide, dust rises.

lines.zh: 巨喙发出低吼，向你进攻。
lines.en: Mouth rumbles, attacks you.

lines.zh: 喙尖啄穿你的肩。
lines.en: My beak punches through your shoulder.

lines.zh: 翅膀横抽，骨头作响。
lines.en: A wing slash, and bones crack.

lines.zh: 两爪齐下，抓住不放。
lines.en: Both talons sink and hold.

lines.zh: 我拍起尘土，迷你的眼。
lines.en: I beat up dust into your eyes.

lines.zh: 羽毛划开你的手背。
lines.en: A feather edge opens your hand.

lines.zh: 落地一下，地面塌了。
lines.en: I land once, and the ground gives way.

lines.zh: 从天而降，巨翼划破天际。
lines.en: Descends from above, wings cutting sky.

lines.zh: 从树上跃下，凌空扑击。
lines.en: Leaps from tree, aerial strike.

lines.zh: 黑暗中悄然降临，无声无息。
lines.en: Approaches silently in darkness.

lines.zh: 巨鸟翱翔，阴影落在地上。
lines.en: Vulture soars, shadow falls.

lines.zh: 夜晚降临，它悄然出现。
lines.en: Appears at night's fall.

lines.zh: 从远处的巢穴中飞来。
lines.en: Flies from distant nest.

lines.zh: 从乌云中降下，带着风雨。
lines.en: Descends from stormy clouds.

lines.zh: 在暴风雨中飞行，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Flies in storm, seeks prey.

lines.zh: 夜晚的天空，它缓缓降落。
lines.en: Gently descends, night's sky.

lines.zh: 在雷声中出现，闪电照亮。
lines.en: Appears in thunder, lightning illuminates.

lines.zh: 乌云散开时，我从高处落下。
lines.en: When the clouds part, I drop from above.

lines.zh: 巢里的枯枝断了，我起飞。
lines.en: The dry branch in my nest snaps; I take off.

lines.zh: 我在悬崖上等到了黄昏。
lines.en: On the cliff I waited for dusk.

lines.zh: 骨头和羽毛散在脚边。
lines.en: Bones and feathers lie at my feet.

lines.zh: 远处那道黑影落了下来。
lines.en: That dark shape in the distance has landed.

lines.zh: 风变冷时，我来了。
lines.en: I arrive when the wind turns cold.

lines.zh: 我绕过山脊，落在空地。
lines.en: I round the ridge and land in the clearing.

lines.zh: 没有叫声，只有翅膀的风。
lines.en: No cry, only the wind of my wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀被火烧了，剧痛难忍。
lines.en: Wings burned by fire, excruciating pain.

lines.zh: 掉下去了，翅膀摔坏了。
lines.en: Fell, wings broken.

lines.zh: 掉进水里了，翅膀被水淹了。
lines.en: Drowned, wings waterlogged.

lines.zh: 被爆炸波及，翅膀炸伤了。
lines.en: Explosion, wings injured.

lines.zh: 被箭射中，翅膀受伤了。
lines.en: Shot by arrow, wings injured.

lines.zh: 被诅咒了，翅膀发炎了。
lines.en: Cursed, wings inflamed.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，翅膀越来越虚弱。
lines.en: Starved, wings weakening.

lines.zh: 被雷劈了，翅膀失去知觉。
lines.en: Lightning struck, wings numb.

lines.zh: 坠入虚空，翅膀无法恢复。
lines.en: Fell into void, wings can't recover.
